# inputs (sha256 first 12): h3_units.tsv f24716bad32d; h3_inventory.tsv 75bb8a75dc47; recurrent_sets.tsv 3c42f67cdd7a; 1_global_our_prior.tsv 68272e907b72; hgnc_complete_set.txt 69bb5722d5a4; primary_lists.json 44fb07b1d2e5; universes.json 25a477fc64ae; meta15_input_datasets.tsv (91 slots, 42 datasets, 15 lists)

# 1 gene bootstrap: positives and negatives resampled with replacement (multinomial over the 16 count levels), 10,000 resamples; 1b positives only. 2 list bootstrap: 15 lists drawn with replacement (integer multiplicities, so a gene on a doubled list counts twice), AUROC recomputed, 2,000 resamples. 2b Bayesian bootstrap: Dirichlet(1,...,1) x 15 weights on the lists. 3 dataset bootstrap: the 42 distinct datasets drawn with replacement; each list gets weight = (draws of its own datasets) / (its number of datasets), so unweighted at weight 1; the lists are not recomputed from the datasets (not possible: the meta-analysis results are not gene-level data we hold). 3b: a list stays whole (weight 1) when at least one of its datasets is drawn; resamples with fewer than 3 lists skipped. p2_5, p50, p97_5 = percentiles of the resamples; bias = mean of resamples minus observed
